description: A real, minimal building-footprint data source — the same small Klosterneuburg area city-roads covers, aligned to the same coordinate origin. Publishes one entity per real OSM building (footprint polygon, ground position, height — real where tagged, a documented estimate where not) plus a real building_attribution string. Keyless, free, ODbL OSM data only — NOT the photorealistic Google 3D Tiles/Cesium ingestion, which needs a real external account/API key decision.
author: prackoreal
